prompt: Fix every occurrence of the misspelling 'recieve' in docs/*.md and open a PR.
rationale: Explicit target, mechanical edit, trivially verifiable.

prompt: Bump the version in desktop/package.json to the next patch version and open a PR titled with the new version.
rationale: One field, one file, reversible.

prompt: Add a .editorconfig at the repo root: 2-space indentation for TypeScript and JSON, 4-space for Python, LF line endings.
rationale: New standalone file with explicit contents.

prompt: In AGENTS.md, add a bullet under Conventions saying that unit tests never make network calls. Open a PR.
rationale: Single documented edit.

prompt: Run `make lint` and tell me whether it passes. Do not change any files.
rationale: Status check, no edits.

prompt: List every GitHub Actions workflow under .github/workflows with the events that trigger it.
rationale: Extraction from a small, explicit set of files.

prompt: Which prompt file under agent/resources/prompts contains the text 'Plan mode is active'? Give me the path and line number.
rationale: Direct lookup.

prompt: Make sure `logs/` is ignored by git. Add it to .gitignore if it is missing and open a PR; otherwise tell me it is already there.
rationale: Explicit target with a one-line check.

prompt: In evals/reviewer/run_eval.py rename the constant DEFAULT_LANGSMITH_PROJECT to DEFAULT_EVAL_PROJECT and update its uses inside that same file. Run ruff and open a PR.
rationale: Localized rename with an explicit scope and lint as verification.

prompt: How many tools are registered in agent/tools/__init__.py? List their names alphabetically.
rationale: Extraction from one file.

prompt: Give me the last 20 commit subjects on main as a markdown bullet list.
rationale: Mechanical git operation.

prompt: Update the installation section of INSTALLATION.md to state that pnpm is required for the ui, desktop and tests/e2e workspaces. Open a PR.
rationale: Small documented edit with a clear target.

prompt: The save_plan tool only accepts paths directly under /workspace/plans. Make it also accept an absolute path anywhere under the sandbox home, normalize it, and add tests covering both forms.
rationale: Bounded behavior change across a tool and its tests.

prompt: Add a --dry-run flag to evals/reviewer/run_eval.py that prints the fully resolved config as JSON and exits without touching LangSmith or LangGraph. Cover it with a test.
rationale: Small feature touching config resolution, argument parsing and tests.

prompt: Thread titles are capped at 80 characters in agent/thread_title.py. Make the cap configurable via an environment variable, keep 80 as the default, and extend tests/test_thread_title.py.
rationale: Ordinary change with existing tests to update.

prompt: tests/e2e/dev-mock.sh assumes an OpenAI key. Work out what it takes to run it against Anthropic instead, make the script support both, and document it in tests/e2e/README.md.
rationale: Bounded investigation plus a scripted change and docs.

prompt: Every logger call in agent/desktop_branch.py interpolates values into the message. Convert them to static messages with values in `extra`, following AGENTS.md, and make sure no `extra` key collides with LogRecord fields.
rationale: Multi-site refactor within one module with a documented convention.

prompt: PlanModeMiddleware filters tools by name and accepts tools given as dicts. Add unit tests proving dict tools and BaseTool instances are both filtered, and that a tool without a name passes through.
rationale: Test-only work requiring reading the middleware's contract.

prompt: Add a dashboard API endpoint that lists the OEPs in the oeps/ directory with number, title and status parsed from each file's header. Include tests.
rationale: New endpoint with parsing, following existing dashboard route patterns.

prompt: Make render_prompt in agent/prompts.py raise an error that names the missing placeholder and the prompt file instead of a bare KeyError, and update tests/test_prompts.py.
rationale: Small semantic change with a test contract to preserve.

prompt: Add a scripted scenario to tests/e2e/fake_llm.py that calls the web_search tool, and a Playwright spec asserting the search result card renders in the transcript.
rationale: Multi-file implementation across the fake model and E2E specs.

prompt: Add a Makefile target `e2e-one SPEC=<file>` that runs a single browser E2E spec from tests/e2e with the same environment the CI job uses. Document it in tests/e2e/README.md.
rationale: Requires understanding the CI job and the e2e runner, but bounded.

prompt: On the admin settings page in ui/, warn inline when the fast, balanced and performance routing models are set to the same model. Add a component test.
rationale: UI change with a test in an existing component.

prompt: agent/tools/enter_plan_mode.py and agent/tools/exit_plan_mode.py both resolve the thread id and plan status in slightly different ways. Extract the shared pieces into one helper module and keep behavior identical. Existing tests must pass.
rationale: Behavior-preserving refactor with a test net.

prompt: Write a script under scripts/ that lists LangGraph threads whose latest run ended in error more than N days ago and prints them as CSV with thread id, title and error time.
rationale: Standalone script against a known API.

prompt: Add retries with exponential backoff to the GitHub token refresh in agent/github/token.py for 5xx responses only, with tests for the retry and the give-up paths.
rationale: Ordinary reliability fix with clear acceptance criteria.

prompt: Design and implement per-organization rate limiting for run starts across the dashboard, Slack and GitHub webhooks, with a shared budget store and graceful degradation when the store is unavailable.
rationale: Cross-component architecture with consequential failure modes.

prompt: Two runs starting on the same thread within a second can end up with two sandboxes. Find the root cause in agent/sandboxes and fix it without introducing a global lock.
rationale: Novel root-cause reasoning under a design constraint.

prompt: Propose and implement splitting the agent graph into a planner subgraph and an executor subgraph while keeping existing threads' transcripts and checkpoints working.
rationale: Architecture change with compatibility constraints.

prompt: Migrate per-thread agent settings from LangGraph thread metadata to the LangGraph Store, including a backfill for existing threads, dual-read during rollout, and a rollback plan.
rationale: Data migration with rollout and rollback judgment.

prompt: Slack replies sometimes land in the wrong thread when a code channel is promoted while a run is in progress. Investigate across agent/slack and the dashboard threads code and fix the underlying cause.
rationale: Conflicting evidence across components; subtle concurrency.

prompt: Make the reviewer graph incremental: re-review only files changed since the last reviewed sha and reconcile findings already published on the PR, resolving ones that no longer apply.
rationale: Semantic reconciliation logic with high-stakes user-visible output.

prompt: Introduce an authorization model where organization admins restrict which repositories each user may target, enforced consistently in the dashboard API, every webhook, and the agent's git tools.
rationale: Security boundary spanning several entry points.

prompt: Redesign conversation offloading so summaries preserve tool-result provenance and keep the prompt prefix cache-friendly. Change the middleware and the transcript UI accordingly.
rationale: Architectural tradeoffs across middleware and UI.

prompt: Support a single thread that clones and opens PRs in two repositories, with PRs cross-linked and a clean rollback if the second PR fails to open.
rationale: Multi-repository judgment with partial-failure handling.

prompt: Audit the sandbox file API for path traversal and symlink escapes, write regression tests for each vector you find, and fix them.
rationale: Consequential security work with weak upfront specification.

prompt: hello! just checking you're online
rationale: No code work; answer directly and stay pre-routed.

prompt: Thanks, that was helpful. Nothing else for now.
rationale: Conversation close; nothing to route.

prompt: In two sentences, what is Open SWE?
rationale: Answerable from the system prompt without touching the repo.

prompt: Which model profile are you running on right now?
rationale: Meta question about the session; no routing needed.
